editorial.blurb: Pingpong delivers consistently flavorful Chinese and Thai cuisine in a cozy, well-appointed setting where attentive service and quality cocktails make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Come early (before 7pm) on weeknights for a quieter experience, and order family-style with a group to sample more dishes—the staff excels at sharing recommendations and wrapping leftovers beautifully for excellent reheating later.
signatureDishes: Soft shell salt and pepper crab
